name: DDM-38
description: DDM-38, also referred to as DDM or DeeDee, was a droid with feminine programming that served General Brendol Hux at the Imperial academy on Arkanis. The droid continued serving Hux after he joined the First Order, a remnant of the Old Empire. She accompanied him on a mission to recruit warriors on the ruined planet of Parnassos. DeeDee was lost during a skirmish between the Scyre and Claw clans.
